svg.text: repotruck · devuser (auth: gh-cli) · preset: categorized · root: /tmp/repotruck-shots-ws · 13 repos
[Sync] Clone repository by URL or owner/name — [c]
[Sync] Scan disk & adopt untracked Git repositories — scan --adopt
[Sync] Refresh GitHub & local workspace state — reload
[Go] Go to Sync Center — bulk sync with every flag plus watch mode — [v s]
[Go] Go to Settings — configuration, auth, update and completions — [v a]
[Go] Go to Agents — AGENTS.md templates, exports and MCP server — [v g]
[Go] Go to Log — captured errors, warnings and runtime diagnostics — [v l]
[Go] Go to Cockpit — scope, repository list and activity — active · [Esc]
[Go] Go to Code Search — tree-sitter symbol, text and regex search — [v e]
[Repo] Archive repository on GitHub + move to archived/ — [A]
Tab switches mode · Up/Down/PgUp/PgDn/Wheel browse · Enter executes · Escape closes
[Tab] Focus [Space] Select [?] Help [q] Quit [:] Omnibar [/] Search [f] Health
